name: Perplexity Comet
desc: Free AI browser whose assistant acts on pages across tabs.
desc_zh: 免费 AI 浏览器，助手可跨标签页直接操作网页。
solves: The research sits in one tab, the form in another, and you are the one shuttling data between them. Its assistant acts across tabs.
solves_zh: 资料在一个标签页，表单在另一个，来回复制粘贴的是你。它的助手可以跨标签页直接操作。
best_for: When a task needs you to read, compare, and fill in a form across several sites.
best_for_zh: 当一个任务需要你在几个网站之间读、比、再填表时。
notes: Went from a $200/month Max-plan exclusive to free for everyone in three months, and is now the largest AI browser by share. 来源：https://www.ithome.com/tags/Comet
